commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
90+2' Sandi Lovric (Verona) will take a corner kick.
90+2' Sandi Lovric (Verona) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90+2' Tomas Suslov (Verona) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90+1' Tomas Suslov (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jean Butez, who smothers the ball.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Martin Frese (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Marco Di Bello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
89' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Lucas Da Cunha (Como), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
87' Corner kicks – 5:7. The fouls committed statistics – 15:14.
84' Cesc Fabregas appears to have said too much and referee Marco Di Bello comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
84' A dangerous towering header by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
84' Martin Baturina (Como) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
83' Nico Paz (Como) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Como will take a corner kick.

81' A sweet pass finds Martin Baturina (Como) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top right corner. Lorenzo Montipo is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
81' Martin Baturina (Como) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ioan Vermesan (Verona) will replace Rafik Belghali.
81' Substitution. Assane Diao leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como).
80' Here is a change. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro is going off and Paolo Sammarco gives the last tactical orders to Isaac (Verona).
80' Assane Diao (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Como will have a corner.
77' Victor Nelsson (Verona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
77' Celebrations are cut short for Verona as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
75' Wait! Referee Marco Di Bello immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
75' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Kieron Bowie (Verona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
74' Sandi Lovric (Verona) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

74' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Tomas Suslov (Verona). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.

74' A through ball from Martin Baturina (Como) fails to reach Nico Paz as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Nico Paz could have got into a promising position.

71' 0 - 1 Goal! Marc Oliver Kempf displays great vision and sends a pass to Anastasios Douvikas (Como), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 0:1.
70' The total number of attempts is 8:7. The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
70' Martin Baturina (Como) will deliver the corner kick.
69' Nico Paz (Como) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Como earn a corner.
69' The resulting corner from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is cleared.

69' Martin Baturina (Como) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Como will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Tomas Suslov (Verona) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Como have a free kick.
68' Ivan Smolcic (Como) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
67' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) commits a foul and Marco Di Bello immediately signals a free kick.
63' Here comes a substitution. Antoine Bernede is given a rest as he is replaced by Sandi Lovric (Verona).
62' Victor Nelsson (Verona) meets the free kick and unleashes a header from the edge of the box, but it's not powerful enough to trouble Jean Butez.
61' Maxence Caqueret (Como) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
61' Rafik Belghali passes to Kieron Bowie (Verona), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes well wide of the left post.
59' A rebound falls at the feet of Antoine Bernede (Verona) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
58' Maxence Caqueret (Como) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Di Bello signals. Free kick. Verona will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
58' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
57' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Da Cunha (Como) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Lorenzo Montipo is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
55' Alberto Moreno (Como) is flagged for offside.
55' The game is interrupted as Martin Frese (Verona) is flagged offside.
52' Martin Frese (Verona) sends a long cross over to Kieron Bowie, but Jean Butez comes forward to gather the ball.
52' Maxence Caqueret (Como) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marco Di Bello blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Verona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
51' A pass by Ivan Smolcic (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
50' Anastasios Douvikas is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Martin Baturina (Como).
50' Como hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
47' Assane Diao (Como) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Cesc Fabregas gives a chance to Maxence Caqueret and Maximo Perrone (Como) is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jesus Rodriguez (Como) comes off for Martin Baturina.
46' Cesc Fabregas makes a switch. Ivan Smolcic is coming on in place of Mergim Vojvoda (Como) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Di Bello starts the second half.
45+3' 1 - 0 The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) whips in a cross from the corner, but Lorenzo Montipo is well positioned and punches the ball away.
45+3' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Como manage to earn a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Antoine Bernede (Verona) jumps into a tackle and Marco Di Bello signals a foul. Como are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
43' The ball is cleared after Jesus Rodriguez (Como) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
41' Kieron Bowie (Verona) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.

40' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
39' Referee Marco Di Bello has finally had enough of Paolo Sammarco and brandishes a yellow card at him!
39' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Verona, play can continue.
38' There's a break in play and referee Marco Di Bello must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Verona using VAR. This could be interesting!

37' Victor Nelsson (Verona) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Diego Carlos (Como) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
37' There's an opportunity for Tomas Suslov (Verona) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
36' Alex Valle (Como) is substituted due to injury. Cesc Fabregas gives a chance to Alberto Moreno.
36' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Verona can continue in their attacking effort.
35' 4:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
32' Alex Valle (Como) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
32' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Verona! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Marco Di Bello and both teams have no complaints.
32' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Verona! Let's see what he decides.
32' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

32' Antoine Bernede (Verona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Kieron Bowie (Verona) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He got to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but his header floated over the crossbar.

31' Rafik Belghali (Verona) produces a brilliant low pass into the box, where Tomas Suslov is already waiting. He attempts to dribble past the defence, but one of the defenders does well to dispossess him. PENALTY APPEAL after Tomas Suslov (Verona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
30' Lucas Da Cunha plays a nice corner into the middle of the box, Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is first to react but his headed effort is way off the mark and goes well wide of the left post.
30' Corner kick. Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is ready to send the ball into the box.
30' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Como force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

28' Antoine Bernede (Verona) sends a killer pass through the opponent's defence in an effort to find a space for Roberto Gagliardini, who is lurking close to the offside line. Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
28' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

27' Tomas Suslov (Verona) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Kieron Bowie was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat. Verona have a corner.
26' The resulting corner from Tomas Suslov (Verona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
26' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nicolas Valentini (Verona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Verona force a corner. They send men into the box.
24' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Jesus Rodriguez (Como). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
21' Tomas Suslov (Verona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
20' Martin Frese (Verona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Jean Butez is alert and denies him with a nice save.

20' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Rafik Belghali with a fine lofted pass. Kieron Bowie (Verona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
19' Como are seeing far more of the ball now.
17' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
16' 28:72 – the ratio of ball possession.
16' Assane Diao nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Nico Paz (Como), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
14' Diego Carlos (Como) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
14' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
13' Good clearance! Mergim Vojvoda (Como) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Now Como have a corner.
13' Jean Butez (Como) picks out Assane Diao with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range. The ball is out of play. Como will take a throw-in.

10' Kieron Bowie almost found himself in a promising position after Antoine Bernede (Verona) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
9' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) meets a cross inside the box, but Lorenzo Montipo wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
8' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) sprays a pass out to Lucas Da Cunha, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
7' Anastasios Douvikas receives a short pass from Jesus Rodriguez (Como), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort.
6' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
6' It could have been a good chance to score! Tomas Suslov (Verona) fails to release Martin Frese with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
5' A clumsy foul by Assane Diao (Como) and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle.
4' Flag up against Kieron Bowie (Verona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
3' Tomas Suslov (Verona) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

3' Tomas Suslov (Verona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Jean Butez is alert and denies him with a nice save. Verona win a corner.
1' The first half has started.
Verona will kick the game off.
Marco Di Bello will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
